newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: France's Giat in farm company offset in UAE.
newsitem.headline: France's Giat in farm company offset in UAE.

text.p: France's Giat Industries is setting up an agricultural export company in the United Arab Emirates with other partners as part of its obligation to offset a $3.62 billion tank deal with the Gulf Arab state.

The UAE Offsets Group said in a statement on Monday the company -- UAE Produce Export Company (UPEC) -- was a venture between the UAE firms Al Ain International Group, East West International Group, the French state-owned Giat and Delphi Defence International, part of the Hitec Group of companies.
"The primary object of UPEC is to counsel and support UAE farmers and to export their produce to European destinations," it said.
The venture is one of several offset projects that Giat has launched in the UAE, an oil-rich state that has emerged as a key customer in the international arms bazaar.
Giat clinched the $3.62 billion deal in 1993 to supply the UAE with Leclerc main battle tanks.

International arms manufacturers supplying the UAE are required to invest a portion of their proceeds in profitable ventures with a local partner -- normally on a 49/51 basis -- under the terms of the offset programme.
